about.title: Targon
about.subtitle: Confidential Decentralized AI Cloud
about.problem: Current AI infrastructure lacks security guarantees for sensitive workloads. Traditional cloud platforms cannot provide verifiable computation or protect proprietary models and data during execution, creating trust and security barriers for enterprise AI deployment.
about.solution: Targon provides a secure AI infrastructure platform leveraging Confidential Compute (CC) and Protected PCIe (PPCIE) technology. Hardware-enforced security enables verifiable and trustworthy operations across the entire decentralized infrastructure.
about.validators: Orchestrate competitive bidding rounds where miners submit price proposals for secure compute resources. Verify hardware attestation and security guarantees while selecting the most cost-effective bids.
about.miners: Compete in price bidding auctions to provide secure AI infrastructure using NVIDIA Confidential Compute or PPCIE technology. Submit competitive bids that drive down costs while maintaining hardware-enforced memory encryption.

benchmark.benchmark_description: Maximize the number of LLM tokens processed.
